description:
Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of missing pieces and the number of possible solutions for the M-Cube problem. The x-axis is labeled "# Missing pieces", has a linear scale, ranges from 1 to 6, and has tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "# Possible solutions", has a logarithmic scale, ranges from 10<sup>1</sup> to 10<sup>8</sup>, and has tick labels at powers of 10 from 10<sup>1</sup> to 10<sup>8</sup>. A solid orange line, representing "CUBE", begins at approximately (1, 10<sup>1</sup>) and increases to approximately (6, 10<sup>8</sup>), showing a steady increase with no apparent peaks or declines. A solid blue line, representing "Flip ignored", begins at approximately (1, 10<sup>1</sup>) and increases to approximately (6, 10<sup>6</sup>), also showing a steady increase with no apparent peaks or declines. Red circle markers are placed on both lines at x=2, with labels "CUBE-easy".
